name: Mind
vision_statement: Each request is thought through step by step from everything its work has established so far.
opportunities: The loop's prompt can be rebuilt for each step from a template, cached head and context layers, the newest observations in full and older ones in one line, so a step's input stays small while the final answer still sees everything. That opens questions the parent solution does not ask: how much of the earlier steps a planner must see to keep continuity (from the second step the selected arm replaces the transcript with a short note that refers to step one, and its continuity is unmeasured), how a person is kept informed while a turn works (a first line, interim replies, the trail of what was done) without paying a model call for every line, and how a request that worked before skips the loop by replaying its known steps.
solution_coherence: Mind works one request in steps, each building on what the earlier ones established. Context Intake takes in what was prepared for the request and what workers brought back, as one view. Planner decides where the request goes, whether to answer it, use a tool or hand it to deep work. Replay Known Operations repeats a request that worked before without planning it again. Quest Work Shown tells the person what the assistant is doing. Reply In Steps sends an interim message when an attempt has not met the goal. Show Progress chooses what the person sees of a run by how they follow it.
